title: How much time goes into choosing?
hook: Two comparison plans share 30 minutes, including a one-minute setup for every option.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to separate the number of options opened from time spent inspecting them

misconception: Inspecting more options necessarily leaves more time for substantive comparison.
objective: Separate the number of options opened from time spent inspecting them.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: Each option has independent one-minute setup; only full inspections count; all time units are minutes; no decision quality function. Short looks use {A} inspecting; longer looks {B}. Longer chunks repeat the setup less often, within the same budget.
